Privacy & your data

How Unranked handles your information, and your rights over it. Please read before you start.

Who's responsible. Unranked (operated by your gym) is the data controller for your information. For any data question or request, contact us at urbanoutlaws@outlook.com.

What we collect. Your name, sex, and (optionally) age; the test scores and training you log; and an optional profile photo. We don't collect anything else and we don't track you across other sites.

Why, and our legal basis. We use it only to build your athlete card, stats, Total Power and rankings. Our legal basis is your consent, which you give by ticking the box on the welcome screen and can withdraw at any time.

Where it's kept. During this beta everything is stored only on this device, in your browser — it is not uploaded to any server. When the full app launches you'll be asked to create an account and your data will move to secure, access-controlled storage then.

Who sees it. Your scores are visible to you and to gym coaches (who verify them and run the rankings). We never sell your data or share it with advertisers.

How long. We keep your data while you're an active member. Rankings reset each year (the annual wipe). You can clear it yourself any time, below.

Your rights. You can access, correct, export or delete your data, and withdraw consent — using the buttons in the app, or by contacting us. You can also complain to the UK ICO (ico.org.uk).

Age. Unranked is for members aged 16 or over. If you're under 16, please use it only with a parent or guardian's permission.

Good to know. This is a private beta for testing. Scores are self-entered and coach-verified; nothing here is medical or fitness advice.
